text:
Nina (Design): draft prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/onboard-suggest?node-id=2%3A10 — experiment: inline language detection + sample tiles instead of static list.
Ravi (PM): interesting. what's the intended primary win? fewer clicks to a working demo?
Nina (Design): exactly. cut the 'pick a sample' friction by surfacing 1-2 targeted starters and a clear 'Not these' action.
Jordan (Eng): technical callout: detection should be client-only where possible. we can parse `package.json`, `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml` heuristically.
Ava (DevEx): UX nit: when detection fails, don't show an empty state — show a small set of popular starters and a CTA "Browse all samples".
Tess (A11y): contrast check: the pill label on the sample card (e.g., "Quick") is 3:1 on the mock. needs to be >=4.5:1 for small text or increase size.
Nina (Design): good catch. I'll update the token to `text-800` or make the pill bold.
Ravi (PM): copy for privacy disclosure: "We scan your repo filenames in your browser to suggest starters — nothing is uploaded." any shorter variants?
Jordan (Eng): keep precise. Implementation: browser parse, no network unless user selects a starter template. we'll add telemetry opt-in later.
Ava (DevEx): session behavior: remember "skip suggestions" in session storage. if they choose "always personalize", persist to account preferences with a toggle.
Tess (A11y): also ensure dynamic replacement announces: \"Suggested samples available\" via `aria-live=polite`. if user interacts with keyboard, focus should jump to primary CTA of first suggested card.
Nina (Design): propose banner copy: \"We found starter projects that match this repo. Try one to get going fast.\" shorter alt: \"Suggested starters for this repo.\"
Ravi (PM): subtle ask: show estimated run time category on cards: "Quick (<5m)", "Setup (10m+)" — helps set expectations.
Jordan (Eng): rough estimates only — client can detect common build steps and classify. add a help tooltip: "Estimate depends on your machine."
Ava (DevEx): accessibility: keyboard order should remain stable during replacements to avoid confusion. animate with fade, not layout shift.
Nina (Design): visual change: add a tiny disclosure link under the banner: "How we pick suggestions" -> docs. will include microcopy on detection rules.
onboard-bot: Preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/onboard-suggest (staging)
Ravi (PM): QA checklist before merge: privacy copy approved, a11y checklist ticked, metrics event for suggestion shown/clicked.
Tess (A11y): preflight checklist: 1) color contrast for pills and CTAs, 2) aria-live for container, 3) focus management on replace, 4) screen reader walkthrough recorded.
Jordan (Eng): I'll prototype the client parser this week. can someone pair on the screen reader test?
Ava (DevEx): I'll do SR testing with Jordan tomorrow. also can add a help tooltip for discontinued languages.
Nina (Design): thanks all 496 I'll push updated frames and copy by EOD. ping me if you want to review wording.
Ravi (PM): thanks — filing tracking ticket now. :white_check_mark:
